$comment: Delivered by tannergolden/ai. Overwritten in full on the next sync.
Gemini CLI fingerprints project hooks: when this command changes, the
hook is treated as new and untrusted and you are asked to approve it
again. A sync that alters this file therefore prompts once, by design.
The event is BeforeAgent, which is Gemini's equivalent of Claude Code's
UserPromptSubmit; no event name is shared between the two.

The command uses the plain $GEMINI_PROJECT_DIR form deliberately. Gemini resolves ${VAR:-DEFAULT} in settings at LOAD time, so the braced form collapses to '.' before the hook runner ever sees it; the plain form is the only spelling the runner substitutes at hook time.
